title: Calibration Proctor: automated accuracy validation with dynamic golden curation
creator: Miguel Torres
description: Build 'Calibration Proctor', an automated accuracy validation harness that evaluates FP8/INT8 quantization profiles using a dynamically curated golden prompt set and multi-metric pass/fail gates. The harness should run as part of model onboarding and CI for rollout pipelines (canary/cutover), produce telemetry compatible with Console dashboards, and provide actionable diagnostics (layer-level breakdowns, top failing prompts, adversarial perturbation summaries). Support integration with model registry to pull candidate model artifacts and with experiment metadata to record calibration configs.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can ingest a model artifact (float32) and a candidate quant profile (FP8/INT8) and run a deterministic eval producing a report within configured timeout
Dynamic golden curation: system selects a reproducible subset of golden prompts from a larger corpus based on prompt fingerprinting and coverage heuristics

Metrics: compute cosine similarity on embeddings, answer-level EM/F1 for QA prompts, ROUGE-L for summarization, top-k token drift and average logit delta for generative QA; all metrics surfaced to dashboard
Pass/fail gates: configurable per-project thresholds; harness returns non-zero exit code for CI if gate fails and posts a detailed failure artifact to S3/drive

Per-prompt explanations: for any failing prompt provide nearest-neighbor examples, token-level divergence heatmap, and suggested remediation label (e.g., increase calibration steps, disable per-layer quant, fall back to mixed-precision)
CI integration: GitHub PR check that runs a fast smoke subset, and a scheduled full run on model release that triggers canary rollout if gates pass
Telemetry: rollout hooks emit metrics compatible with Console rollout and cost dashboards, including per-token latency and cost delta estimates for quant profile
Adversarial perturbation mode: harness can run N deterministic perturbations per prompt and report robustness score
